name: H100 reference column for MI300X vs H100, vLLM/TRT-LLM, Llama 3.1 405B FP8 TP8: output token throughput at 128-in/4096-out
unit: output tok/s (aggregate over all in-flight requests)
methodology: NVIDIA half of the 405B head-to-head, identical conditions to the paired MI300X record. Llama 3.1 405B FP8, TP=8, input 128 / output 4096, 8x H100 SXM on Xeon, trtllm-bench trtllm 0.16.0. OMITTED BY SOURCE: batch size, max_num_seqs, KV-cache dtype, GEMM tuning state, TensorRT-LLM engine flags, CUDA version.
notes: DIRECTLY COMPARABLE to mi300x-vs-h100-vllm-llama31-405b-fp8-tp8-output-throughput. Same honesty caveats: NVIDIA data measured by AMD; engine mismatch (TensorRT-LLM vs vLLM). Read alongside the 70B pair - the contrast between 0.96x at 70B and 1.62x at 405B is the actual finding, and it is the most decision-relevant ROCm-vs-CUDA datapoint in the repo.
